settings.title: settings
settings.description: Manage SimpMC-Motd settings and group server mappings in the AstrBot console.
settings.subtitle: Manage MOTD queries, group server mappings, and status images from the AstrBot console.

notice.title: Console-only configuration
notice.body: MOTD settings can only be changed on this AstrBot WebUI page. Chat commands cannot change or clear settings.

server.title: Default server
server.description: Sessions without their own mapping use this Minecraft Java server.

access.title: Session access
access.description: Choose which sessions may generate images. All settings remain console-only.

groups.title: Group servers
groups.description: Bind individual platform group sessions to different servers. Changes apply after saving.

runtime.title: Queries and cache
runtime.description: Balance query frequency, image generation speed, and AstrBot resource usage.

background.title: Image background
background.description: Configure the status image background and safe remote-download limits.

history.title: Charts and history
history.description: Control the chart window, SQLite retention period, and plotted point count.

server_name.label: Display name
server_name.help: The server name shown at the top of the status image.

host.label: Server host
host.help: Enter a hostname or IP only; configure the port separately.

allow_private_chat.label: Allow private queries
allow_private_chat.help: Generate an image when motd or /motd is sent in a private chat.

use_default_server_for_unconfigured_grou.label: Use default for unmapped groups
use_default_server_for_unconfigured_grou.help: When off, each group must have a server mapping below.

enable_group_whitelist.label: Enable group allowlist
enable_group_whitelist.help: Only groups in the allowlist or group server mappings may query.

group_whitelist.label: Group allowlist
group_whitelist.help: Separate entries with commas, spaces, or new lines. Use a platform prefix for exact isolation.

background_image_url.label: Background image URL
background_image_url.help: Leave empty for the built-in background. Only HTTP(S) images resolving to public IPs are accepted.

latency_warning_ms.label: High-latency threshold
latency_warning_ms.help: Successful samples above this value show as yellow points; connection failures always show as red bars.

groups.caption: Group sessions and Minecraft server mappings
groups.name: Display name
groups.emptyBody: Unmapped groups follow the default-server setting above.

status.loadingDetail: Reading the current settings from the plugin backend…
status.savedNeedsReload: Settings were saved, but the plugin must be reloaded before they fully apply.

errors.invalidSettings: The server returned invalid settings data.
errors.invalidResponse: The server returned an unrecognized response.
errors.requestFailed: The request could not be completed.
errors.unknown: An unknown error occurred. Check the AstrBot console log.
errors.fixFields: Correct the highlighted settings before saving.
